description: This PHP source file defines a class 'perf_db2' for performance monitoring and tuning of DB2 databases. It includes SQL statements, configuration settings for cache ratios, buffers, connections, and methods for explaining and listing database tables.

classes.name: perf_db2
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring and tuning specific to IBM DB2 databases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a database connection reference.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an EXPLAIN plan for a given SQL query and appends the output to a string, with options for partial explanations.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and formats a list of tables from the database, excluding system schemas.
